test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following sessions of Indian National Congress was the first session to be presided by a lady?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta - 1917**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• In 1917, at the Calcutta session, Annie Basant was the first lady president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• In 1925, at the Kanpur session, Sarojini Naidu was the first Indian lady president of the Indian National Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
